;---------------------------------------------------
;Setup
;---------------------------------------------------
               ORG     #9c40
               LD      A,(cursym)
               LD      (symba),A
               CALL    mains
               LD      A,(symba)
               LD      (cursym),A
               RET
savem          LD      IX,stwin4
               JR      izzc
irc            CALL    animal
               CALL    checkw
               JR      irc

lda            RET

mains          LD      IX,stwin5
               CALL    setwin
               JR      irc
color
               LD      IX,stwin1
izzc           CALL    setwin
               CALL    irc
               LD      IX,stwin5
               CALL    frfsh
               RET
autol
               LD      IX,stwin3
               JR      izzc
pointer        LD      IX,stwin2
               JR      izzc
prc_1          LD      A,(symba)
               INC     A
               CP      13
               JR      NZ,pp_1
               INC     A
pp_1           LD      (symba),A
               CALL    rfsh
               RET
prc_2
               LD      A,(symba)
               DEC     A
               CP      13
               JR      NZ,pp_1
               DEC     A
               JR      pp_1
               RET
slt_1          LD      DE,music
               JR      sptnm
slt_2          LD      DE,back
               JR      sptnm
slt_3          LD      DE,font
               JR      sptnm
slt_4          LD      DE,skin
               JR      sptnm
slt_5          LD      DE,atplug
sptnm
               PUSH    DE
               CALL    getfil
               CALL    gtadr
               POP     DE
               LD      A,#10
               CALL    page
               LD      A,(fnm)
               CP      #ff
               RET     Z
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               RET
fsav           CALL    savset
               CALL    savicq_1
               RET

savset         LD      HL,setnm
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      C,10
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,C
               CP      #ff
               JR      NZ,sv_1
               LD      HL,setnm
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      DE,#100
               LD      HL,#6100
               LD      C,11
               CALL    dos
               RET
sv_1           LD      C,8
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,(#5cec)
               LD      D,A
               LD      A,(#5ceb)
               LD      E,A
               LD      BC,#106
               LD      HL,#6100
               CALL    dos
               RET


savspr         LD      HL,icons
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      C,10
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,C
               CP      #ff
               JR      NZ,sv_2
               LD      HL,icons
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      A,#13
               CALL    page
               LD      DE,#97e
               LD      HL,sprts
               LD      C,11
               CALL    dos
               RET
sv_2           PUSH    AF
               LD      A,#13
               CALL    page
               POP     AF
               LD      C,8
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,(#5cec)
               LD      D,A
               LD      A,(#5ceb)
               LD      E,A
               LD      BC,#a06
               LD      HL,sprts
               CALL    dos
               RET
savicq_1               LD HL,icc
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      C,10
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,C
               CP      #ff
               JR      NZ,sv_3
               LD      HL,icc
               LD      DE,#5cdd
               LD      BC,9
               LDIR
               LD      A,#13
               CALL    page
               LD      DE,#97e
               LD      HL,(ictbl)
               LD      C,11
               CALL    dos
               RET
sv_3
               LD      C,8
               CALL    dos
               LD      A,(#5cec)
               LD      D,A
               LD      A,(#5ceb)
               LD      E,A
               LD      BC,#a06
               LD      HL,(ictbl)
               CALL    dos
               RET

stwin1         DB      3,3,7,7
               DW      snam1,lda,lda
               DB      16,2,1
               DW      stx_1
               DB      0,20,2,7
               DW      border
               DB      2,20,3,7
               DW      winatr
               DB      4,20,4,7
               DW      butatr
               DB      4,20,5,7
               DW      nameatr
               DB      4,20,6,7
               DW      chbxatr
               DB      4,20,7,7
               DW      koncol
               DB      4,#FF
stwin2         DB      5,6,7,3
               DW      snam2,lda,lda
               DB      16,2,1
               DW      stx_2
               DB      0,11,2,8
               DW      prc_1
               DB      0,10,2,9
               DW      prc_2
               DB      0,20,3,6
               DW      step
               DB      2,#FF
stwin3         DB      8,9,8,6
               DW      snam3,lda,lda
               DB      17,2,1
               DW      optt_1
               DB      9,17,3,1
               DW      optt_2
               DB      9,17,4,1
               DW      optt_3
               DB      9,17,5,1
               DW      optt_4
               DB      9,17,6,1
               DW      optt_5
               DB      9,#FF
stwin4         DB      8,9,8,2
               DW      snam4,lda,lda
               DB      17,1,1
               DW      optt_6
               DB      9,17,2,1
               DW      optt_7
               DB      9,#FF
stwin5         DB      8,8,7,4
               DW      snam5,lda,lda
               DB      17,1,1
               DW      optt_1a
               DB      6,17,2,1
               DW      optt_2a
               DB      6,17,3,1
               DW      optt_3a
               DB      7,17,4,1
               DW      optt_4a
               DB      6,#FF



stx_1          DB      "Border : ",13
               DB      "Window : ",13
               DB      "Buttons: ",13
               DB      "Name   : ",13
               DB      "C_boxes: ",13
               DB      "Konsol : ",0
stx_2          DB      "Cursor : ["
symba          DB      " ]",13
               DB      "St_step:",0
setnm          DB      "ZXNsetupS"

optt_1         DW      slt_1
               DB      " - Select music -",0
optt_2         DW      slt_2
               DB      " - Select screen -",0
optt_3         DW      slt_3
               DB      "  - Select font -",0
optt_4         DW      slt_4
               DB      "  - Select skin -",0
optt_5         DW      slt_5
               DB      "  - Select ovl -",0
optt_6         DW      fsav
               DB      "Save setup...",0
optt_7         DW      savspr
               DB      "Save sprites...",0
optt_1a        DW      color
               DB      "Color setup.",0
optt_2a        DW      pointer
               DB      "Cursor setup.",0
optt_3a        DW      autol
               DB      "Autoload setup.",0
optt_4a        DW      savem
               DB      "Save sets...",0


icc            DB      "Icons   t"

snam1          DB      "Colors...",0
snam2          DB      "Pointers...",0
snam3          DB      "Autoload...",0
snam4          DB      "Save menu...",0
snam5          DB      "Setup..."
